_about: Professional schematic-layout policy. Cluster definitions, distance thresholds, sheet flow direction. Read by intent/engine.py after the initial placement pass to TIGHTEN component groupings (crystal + load caps, LED + series resistor, reset pullup + NRST pin). All policy lives here -- adding a new cluster type is one JSON entry, zero Python.
_enabled_doc: Master kill switch. When false, all relocators below are skipped --- restores the engine's pre-2026-06-01 placement byte-for-byte.

clusters.name: crystal_load_caps
clusters._doc: Pull the two load capacitors of a crystal so they sit adjacent to the crystal pins on the outward axis. Detected: any 2-pin cap whose only non-GND pin is on a net also connected to a crystal pin.

clusters.name: led_indicator
clusters._doc: LED and its current-limit resistor must sit adjacent. Detected: any resistor sharing a net with an LED, where the LED is on the same net or the next-hop net.

clusters.name: reset_pullup
clusters._doc: Pull-up resistor on NRST/RESET/MCLR pin should sit adjacent to the MCU's reset pin. Detected: 2-pin resistor whose one pin is on a net named NRST / RESET / ~{RESET} / MCLR and whose other pin is on a power rail.

clusters.name: boot_strap
clusters._doc: Boot-select / strap resistors on BOOT0 / BOOT1 / EN / PROG pins -- sit adjacent to the MCU/IC.

clusters.name: i2c_pullups
clusters._doc: I2C SDA/SCL pull-ups should sit at the bus, near the master IC.

sheet_flow._doc: Per-block sheet-flow direction hint. The engine's _compute_flow_dag already orders ICs left-to-right by signal flow; this map adds a per-block override for sheets that should flow top-to-bottom (e.g. programming headers, vertical power chains). Falls back to engine default when a block is unlisted.

wire_label_ratio_hint._doc: Target ratio for the rendered output. The engine doesn't enforce these directly; the architect prompt is tuned to keep them as professional defaults (most short connections become wires, mid-distance become labels, sheet-crossing become hierarchical labels).
